fonts.display: 'Archivo', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Archivo', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Ink
palette.role: Body text, headings, primary borders, icon strokes — the dominant neutral that carries almost all type and structural lines

palette.name: Cream Canvas
palette.role: Page background and deepest warm surface — the base tone of the entire site

palette.name: Warm White
palette.role: Primary card and section surface, nav background, soft fills

palette.name: Paper White
palette.role: Button hover surfaces and elevated neutral blocks, slightly cooler than Warm White

palette.name: Pure White
palette.role: Top-level product card surfaces and modal panels that need to float above cream

palette.name: Sand Border
palette.role: Subtle warm-gray dividers and disabled controls

palette.name: Stone Text
palette.role: Secondary and helper text, muted labels, description copy

palette.name: Charcoal
palette.role: Pure black for SVG icon fills in dark contexts only

palette.name: Terracotta
palette.role: Primary action button fill, the one chromatic accent — warm orange against cream creates urgency without aggression
